===Feature=== *CPU: [[MediaTek]] MT7629BA @1.25GHz (Dual-core) *Flash: 128MB (SPI NAND), RAM: 256MB (DDR3) SDRAM *Interface: UART, PWM, MDC, MDIO, JTAG, I2C, SPI, GPIO, USB *Security: 64/128-bits WEP, TKIP, WPA, WPA2, AES, WPS *WLAN: Data rate up to 1900 Mbps, SIM card slot *Multi-modes: Mi-Fi, AP/Client *LAN: 5x 1GbE LAN ports :;Software *Secure Boot, Crypto Suite *Support OpenWrt, MTK SDK *5G/4G module supported
